hypotheses.persona: A single working professional with a standard Monday-to-Friday office schedule, who eats breakfast at home, commutes with transit, and returns in the evening to have dinner and relax. On weekends, they stay home, have a relaxed schedule, and eat dinner later.
hypotheses.rationale: The weekday pattern is robust and consistent across all observed weekdays (days 0-4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11). Saturday and Sunday show a late start, no commute, later dinner, and late bedtime. This matches a typical weekend routine of a weekday office worker. The remote worker hypothesis is now fully contradicted by the daily commute evidence.
